text:
maya: Quick proposal — let's push per-route default views that show cost+latency by model. Trying to nudge teams towards saved views for their routes. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on surfacing cost early. How do we set defaults without surprising users?

maya: default would be opt-in per org; show a banner the first time, and a small "Use as route default" toggle in the view bar :bell:

jordan: UX question — default saved view vs transient filters. If we persist filters automatically it'll break workflows.

maya: agree. plan is: defaults are a saved-view object (explicit save) but we offer a quick "set as route default" in the save modal.

sam: on telemetry — need an event for default_set, default_unset, and default_apply. Can we piggyback on existing savedquery events?

eli: also track when fallback routing triggers because default model unavailable. that's important for quality regressions.

opsbot: deploy-notice: feature-flag `route_default_views` enabled in staging

jordan: rollouts — prefer gradual enablement by org with flags + admin override in console settings.

maya: about quotas — route defaults could include a "cost cap" filter that warns when expected 24h spend exceeds X. Implementation-wise we can reuse quota eval code.

sam: snippet for events:
```
event: saved_view.default_set
payload: {org_id, route_id, view_id, user_id}
```

eli: tiny ask — include model variant tag in the view metadata (quantization, container) so we know which variant was used for cost numbers.

maya: good call.

jordan: UX nit — when view references multiple models, show per-model columns, not aggregate only.

maya: OK. I'll draft a spec. Anyone want to pair on telemetry mapping and rollouts?

sam: I can take telemetry mapping

eli: i'll do model-variant metadata

jordan: i'll do save modal UX and rollout wiring

maya: thanks all. leaving notes in the doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-1234 :white_check_mark:

sam: :+1:

eli: :rocket:
